title: MRP Subcontracting + Purchase Cross-Module Flow
phase: Second-Pass Depth Closure — P1 Core Business

key_findings.bom_subcontractor_field: mrp.bom.subcontractor_ids is a Many2many to res.partner (junction mrp_bom_subcontractor); identifies authorised subcontractors per BOM
key_findings.mo_creation_trigger: MO is created in StockMove._action_confirm (called when PO is confirmed and receipt move is confirmed); NOT deferred to receipt validation
key_findings.mo_creation_mechanism: StockPicking._subcontracted_produce creates mrp.production records in bulk per company, then immediately calls action_confirm() and action_assign()
key_findings.subcontracting_location: MO uses partner.property_stock_subcontractor (company-dependent, usage=internal) as both src and dest; falls back to company.subcontracting_location_id
key_findings.component_resupply: stock.warehouse.subcontracting_to_resupply=True (default) enables pull rules from lot_stock_id to subcontract location via subcontracting_resupply_type_id (code=internal, seq=RES); route=route_resupply_subcontractor_mto
key_findings.receipt_to_mo_completion: StockPicking._action_done calls _get_subcontract_production().sudo().button_mark_done(); MO auto-closed on receipt validation
key_findings.mo_picking_type: Subcontract MO uses warehouse.subcontracting_type_id (code=mrp_operation, seq=SBC), not the incoming receipt type
key_findings.skip_consumption: pre_button_mark_done adds skip_consumption=True context for subcontract MOs; bypasses component consumption checks
key_findings.bypass_reservation: is_subcontract=True moves bypass warehouse reservation (_should_bypass_reservation returns True)
key_findings.extra_cost_account: mrp_subcontracting_account._cal_price sets extra_cost from bill (_get_value_from_account_move) + PO (_get_value_from_quotation) divided by quantity; _get_aml_value subtracts extra_cost from FG AML to avoid double-count (AVCO/FIFO only)
key_findings.standard_cost_path: account_move_line._get_price_unit_val_dif_and_relevant_qty adds component MO raw move values to price variance for standard cost reconciliation
key_findings.mrp_subcontracting_purchase_presence: EXISTS; adds resupply picking count on PO, source PO navigation on resupply picking, po_to_notify context, lead day computation (max vendor/mfg delay + DTP)
key_findings.dropshipping_subcontracting: mrp_subcontracting_dropshipping EXISTS in Community; stock_rule._prepare_purchase_order sets partner to subcontractor when destination is subcontracting location; purchase.py auto-sets dest_address_id from location.subcontractor_ids
